findings.evidence: Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:64-69, 91-105; roadmap/EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/Diffraction/README.md:177-179: 'Exclusive.Kinematics.Basic for the kinematics of a final state with an identified hadron and hence a momentum transfer `t`, which diffraction reuses rather than re-deriving.'
findings.fix: Build `DiffractiveKinematics` on `ExclKinematics V` (its `hMomentum : p + q = pPrime + qPrime` makes `qPrime` the momentum of `X`), drop `t` in favour of `tMom`, and define `Delta := -K.delta` with a lemma `Delta = K.q - K.qPrime` obtained from the existing `delta_eq_q_sub_qPrime`. That also makes `tMom_eq_photon_transfer_sq` available for the Layer 0.2 `β = Q²/(Q² + M_X² - t)` work.
findings.issue: `t D g = g D.Delta D.Delta` re-derives `ExclKinematics.tMom` (`def tMom (g) (K) : ℝ := g K.delta K.delta`, Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:68-69), and `Delta = K.p - K.pPrime` (line 74) is `ExclKinematics.delta = K.pPrime - K.p` (line 64-65) up to sign — so `t` and `tMom` are the same real number by bilinearity. The file imports only `Kinematics.Basic`.

findings.evidence: Diff lines 66-67 (`/-- The invariant mass squared ... i.e. `(q + P - P')²`. -/ MX2 : ℝ`); roadmap/EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/Diffraction/README.md:279 `M_X² = (q + Δ)²`.
findings.fix: Remove the field and define `def MX2 (D : DiffractiveKinematics V) (g : Bilin V) : ℝ := g (D.K.q + D.Delta) (D.K.q + D.Delta)` (or `g K.qPrime K.qPrime` if the record is rebased on `ExclKinematics`, matching `tMom`'s shape).
findings.issue: `MX2 : ℝ` is an unconstrained structure field, but its own docstring says it is `(q + P - P')²`, which the other fields plus `g` already determine. Nothing ties the field to that value, so the roadmap's `β = Q²/(Q² + M_X² - t)` cannot be stated without a further consistency hypothesis.

findings.fix: Use `extends` (on `ExclKinematics V` per the first finding) so the inclusive accessors and all existing `DisKinematics` lemmas apply without the `.K` indirection.
findings.issue: The record wraps the inclusive kinematics in a field `K` rather than extending it, unlike the existing extension point in the same tree (`structure PolarizedKinematics (g : Bilin V) extends DisKinematics V`, Polarized/Kinematics.lean:66), giving a second, parallel access path (`D.K.p` vs `K.p`) to the same inclusive API.

summary: The new `Delta`/`t` re-derive `ExclKinematics.delta`/`tMom`, and the record is built on `DisKinematics` instead of the off-forward record the roadmap names as the thing diffraction reuses; `MX2` is carried as a free field although it is determined by `K` and `g`.
